d.title: Biao Ren
syn: Biao Ren: Blades of the Guardians
ヒョウ人-Blades of the Guardians
d.synopsis: A extraordinary guard walks in the desert of the Western regions. On the way escaping the killing by the government, he took a guarding task with destination to the capital Chang 'an. The task was thought as just a simple one, but actually it is a road full of crisis and danger. A journey affecting the fate of the world begins...
